summary: A table of short text cells: a responsibility matrix (who prepares, reviews, approves and submits), a software and task matrix, a cost comparison laid out line by line, or a working-hours example. Heading above, the row names in the first column, 1-5 named columns, an optional note under the table (for example "Illustrative example, not a service promise"). On phones every row becomes a card with each cell under its column name. Use only for facts the brief gives; a cell that is not known yet is left out of the table, not filled with a guess.
